name: clean_cut
description: Clean-cut a talking head in one call: transcribes clips that have no transcript (a preview writes those too), cuts silences and fillers, keeps one take of each line, and saves through speech_edit (a version first). With no speech it removes silences only. A project it already cut is left alone unless recut is set.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {project, mode (speech | silence | already-cut), kept {lines, seconds}, removed {takes, fillers, seconds}, duration, text, transcribed, note?, warnings?}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: max-pause
params.description: Cap every pause in seconds. Default 0.45, which suits a talking head; 0.5 or more for tutorials.

params.name: preview
params.description: Answer with the result and change nothing in the project.

params.name: recut
params.description: Cut again a project clean_cut already cut. It cuts the current timeline, so takes the first cut removed stay removed.

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model for clips with no transcript.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code (e.g. es), or 'auto' to detect. Picks the filler set and the transcription language.
